spans.s:
Godhā.--(a) The sense of ‘bowstring’ seems certain in one passage of the Rigveda, and possible in another. Roth also adopts this meaning in the only passage of the Atharvaveda where the word occurs.
(b) In one passage of the Rigveda the sense of ‘musical instrument’ is recognized by Roth and by Hillebrandt for this word.
(c) Elsewhere an animal seems to be meant, perhaps the ‘crocodile,’ as Ludwig and Weber think; perhaps a large ‘lizard,’ as Roth and Zimmer assume. An animal is probably also meant in the Atharvaveda.
